cell_materialization: Before freeze, enumerate f32_painted_interval.CELLS in declared order into objects {case,mode,operation,role}; only sparse64/full is target. The driver requires exact list equality and fixed counts.

new_oracles.f32-shading-dense: 512x512 constant-black axial shading at alpha1/4 over opaque white; RGB191, alpha255 everywhere
new_oracles.f32-pattern-dense: Same constant function through PatternType2 full-page fill; RGB191, alpha255 everywhere

prerequisite_binding_protocol.plan: Freeze this plan's identities, cells, phases, thresholds and policy once before native/WASI preflights; never revise its bytes after those start.
prerequisite_binding_protocol.inputs: Immutable preflight-inputs binding contains the plan pin, source/binary/build identities, runtime and helper closure; native112, SIMD336 and scalar24 all bind this same file.
prerequisite_binding_protocol.admission: A separate native-admission binding copies that entire frozen core and pins completed quality, native preflight and both independently audited WASI records plus explicit descriptive-diagnostic review.
prerequisite_binding_protocol.phases: Pilot and confirmation configs pin the same final admission binding; confirmation adds only completed pilot audit and explicit coordinator decision. No automatic retry or changed gates.

environment.monitoring: Cooperative runner plus strict known-job observer, one owned compute process tree at a time. Retain every refusal/interruption/failure; postlaunch contamination makes the attempt unavailable.

decision.admit: All56 latency/RSS cells and all mandatory correctness,error,resource,layout,provenance,portability and repository-validation gates; release/competitor admission remains separate.
decision.preserve_partial: At least one original target confirmation median upper<=0.95 and every mandatory correctness/resource/layout/provenance/portability gate complete. Record target p95, protected and RSS misses. Protected median or p95 lower>1.02 requires revision or explicit reasoned experimental restriction. Retention is a coordinator decision, never an evaluator side effect.
decision.reject_or_revise: Any independent accuracy,resource accounting,source error,tile-contract or layout failure blocks active retention. Reject/revise completed confirmation without required target median gain. Upper-bound miss alone is not proven regression. Keep all evidence.
decision.sampling: No historical/pilot reuse, postlaunch tuning, automatic retry, replacement of failing cells or resampling until pass.

scope: Incremental native retained render costs; default Repair/full compile, opaque-white analytic references, one thread and warmed filesystem. No competitor, global speed, memory-neutrality or release claim.
freeze_note: Coordinator must fill actual identities/cells, bind exact file bytes and launch chain, and set status=frozen-before-pilot BEFORE preflight. Completed result pins belong only to later immutable bindings/configs. This template alone authorizes no run.
